static_traits.name: Li Jie
static_traits.social_status: 有几位亲密朋友,但尚not yet向他们分享关于寻找新室友的Anxiety
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病;without既往类似心理问题;not yet接受过心理咨询或精神科治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,能具体描述情绪与困扰;情绪基调偏Anxiety与消极;存在灾难化,读心术,预测not yet来,过度概括,个人化等认知偏差;对咨询配合度尚可

basic_info.main_problem: 最近得知室友要搬走,我对寻找一个同样合得来的新室友感到Anxiety.这种Anxiety在室友告知搬走时开始,最初压力很大,担心找not到类似的人选,逐渐发展为对找新室友的持续担忧以及一旦找not到就会感到Loneliness.
basic_info.core_demands: 室友搬走的消息trigger了强烈的Anxiety与对Loneliness的Fear,因此希望在这一过渡期获得咨询支持.
growth_experiences: 曾有一次非常担心考试会失败,但最终考试结果Good.

core_beliefs: 我without法很好地应对变化,事情往往会朝最坏的方向发展
Building rapport with people is difficult; good relationships are hard to obtain again

special_situations.event: Roommate announces they will move out soon; the living relationship will change
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果找not到与现在一样合拍的新室友,我的生活就会变得很糟糕,而且我会很Loneliness
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复预演最坏情景,加重担忧以期提前做好心理准备,但not yet主动广泛求助或系统筛选
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远找not到像现在这样合得来的新室友

special_situations.event: Thinking about getting along with strangers again and establishing rules
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果新关系达not到现在的标准,就等于失败,我会受not了这种落差
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 渴望获得确定性的'保证',提高筛选标准以降低not确定性
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: have not明确的保证,事情就会出问题

special_situations.event: Hearing negative stories others share about 'terrible roommates'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人经历过糟糕室友,我也很可能会遇到类似甚至更糟的状况
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses on the most negative cases to remind self to be careful, further strengthening avoidance and worry
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The new roommate will definitely be terrible; we will argue all the time

special_situations.event: When thinking of confiding in or seeking help from friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我告诉朋友,他们也not会理解,可能会觉得我在麻烦他们
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 选择Silence,独自承受,not主动useSocial support

core_conflict.wish: Longs to maintain a stable, understood, and comfortable intimate/peer relationship, gaining safety and companionship amid change
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被Loneliness感吞噬,害怕亲密关系变差并陷入冲突与失控
defense_goal: Lowers expectations by presetting the worst, avoiding disappointment or being hurt
保持Self-protection与距离(not向朋友求助)以避免可能的拒绝或not被理解
追求确定性与'保证'以暂时缓解对not确定性的Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: 需要被理解且脆弱的个体,面对变化容易Anxiety
object_relations.object_representation: 潜在not可靠/可能产生冲突的新室友
not会理解自己,可能负担过重的朋友

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor explores seeking support from friends or sharing worries
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为朋友not会理解自己,可能会觉得自己在制造负担(移情:将内心的not被理解感投向他人)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以肯定语气简短回应,如'他们not会理解',避免展开细节,语气平淡并尝试Displacement话题.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当面对not确定的not yet来(寻找新室友)并被邀请评估证据与选项时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 以他人'糟糕室友'故事为理由,认为without论如何都会出错
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 引用外部案例作为依据,语气坚信not疑,重复'总会出问题'的判断,弱化反证.

manifestations: 担心找not到同样合得来的新室友
认为朋友'not会理解',避免求助,进一步加剧Loneliness感

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: 虽有几位亲密朋友可谈,但选择not分享Anxiety,独自承受
在强烈Anxiety下not yet积极主动寻求外部支持

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 认为朋友'not会理解自己',据此避免接触与求助
将内在not被理解的担忧归因于他人的态度

exception_events.target_problem: 在面对not确定的not yet来时(如担心找not到合适室友),来访者通常会Catastrophizing并Persistent anxiety,认为事情会朝最坏方向发展.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 曾在一次考试前担心会考砸,但那次考试结果Good,事实与最坏的预测not一致.
exception_events.reason: 线索:可能因事前有一定准备,按部就班应对任务,且现实结果为积极表现,从而出现与灾难化预测not一致的偏离点.

positive_force: 与当前室友关系Good,说明具备建立并维持GoodInterpersonal relationships的能力
Has several close friends, with potential social support resources
Able to propose more prudent screening strategies (stricter interviews, asking trusted people for recommendations)
曾有担心但结果Good的经历,可作为去灾难化的反证素材
negative_force: 灾难化,预测not yet来,过度概括与读心术等认知偏差显著
对not确定性的低耐受与对确定性的过度需求(控制谬误)
回避向他人求助,Social supportnot yet被有效利用
Sleep and appetite disturbed,进一步降低应对能力与功能

target_behavior.behavior: 围绕寻找新室友的持续性灾难化担忧与Anxiety
antecedent: Hearing the roommate will move out
Thinking about the upcoming change of living with strangers
Comes into contact with negative stories about 'bad roommates'
target_behavior.core_reason: 对Loneliness的Fear与对not确定性的低耐受,伴随灾难化与预测not yet来的认知偏差
target_behavior.function: 通过预演最坏结果来获得一种虚假控制感,试图回避not确定性带来的not安
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep disturbance,Decreased appetite,Decline in work concentration,整体功能受损

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids sharing troubles with friends and seeking support
antecedent: 感到Anxiety时想到是否向朋友求助
In situations involving talking about needing support
target_behavior.core_reason: 读心式地预测朋友not会理解,担心麻烦他人或Being rejected
target_behavior.function: 避免潜在的拒绝或负面评价以短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Social supportnot yet能启动,Loneliness与Anxiety维持甚至加重
